Egg whites: the pile covers about half the plate and is fairly thick. I estimate about 150 g. Egg white runs about 50 kcal per 100 g, so that is roughly 75-80 kcal.

Potatoes: about 15 cubes, roughly 80 g. Roasted with oil, they run about 150 kcal per 100 g, so that is roughly 120 kcal.

Total: about 230 g and about 200 kcal.
